none.description:
{Reconstruction}

Target allied unliving (not undead) troop or siege weapon with destroyed creatures has (30 + (power x 50)) health worth of creatures restored to life for the duration of the current battle.

basic.description:
{Basic Reconstruction}

Target allied unliving (not undead) troop or siege weapon with destroyed creatures has (40 + (power x 50)) health worth of creatures restored to life for the duration of the current battle.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Reconstruction}

Target allied unliving (not undead) troop or siege weapon with destroyed creatures has (40 + (power x 50)) health worth of creatures restored to life permanently.

expert.description:
{Expert Reconstruction}

Target allied unliving (not undead) troop or siege weapon with destroyed creatures has (160 + (power x 50)) health worth of creatures restored to life permanently.
